_doc: Kill-switch. paused=true → Maker IDLE. Checker only runs WATCHDOG recovery when by=deploy-watchdog; otherwise Checker IDLEs too.

_last_incident.what: Checker lane deadlocked 2026-08-07..09. locks.json lease.pr held a full URL; Number(lease.pr) → NaN, NaN !== 6 is true, so the oldest open PR always looked superseded and CLOSE_STALE was proposed ahead of REVIEW on every tick. The Checker agent correctly refused at the playbook gate and stopped, so the lane never reached REVIEW and five PRs accumulated.
_last_incident.fix: lease.pr normalized to integers; durable fix (parse number/string/URL, and never read unparseable as superseded) landed in ai-dev-methodologies and arrives on next methodology sync.
_last_incident.verified: ViOS merged its first queued PR on the next Checker tick after the same fix.
_last_incident.expected_next: Five PRs drain oldest-first: #6 (T-0010 notes export), #7 (T-0020 harness status), #8 (T-0030 MiniMax embedding fix), #9 (T-0040 notes filters), #10 (T-0050 portfolio registry). PR #8 is the highest-value one — it fixes why note_search returns empty. WARNING: #6 and #9 both edit packages/lane-memory/src/routes/notes.ts, and #9 was branched before #6 merged, so #9 will probably conflict. A conflicting merge should be bounced to needs_human and rebased by a fresh Maker run — do NOT force-merge it.
